summary: MT-024 Customer-Ready Deliverable backend fully validated. 14/14 pytest tests passed across render-deliverable (Book/Presentation/Poster), asset serving (content-type + magic bytes), pipeline exposure, idempotency, 404 handling, and release gating (published_deliverable snapshot + gate-lock).
critical_code_review_comments: deliverable_renderer.PRIMARY_FORMAT map + validate_deliverable() correctly enforces content>=180 chars, html rendered, primary rendered, and on-disk >=800 bytes — matches ticket spec.
routers/pipeline.py:render_deliverable checks product existence before invoking ensure_deliverable (returns 404 correctly).
manufacturing2.release_product auto-renders deliverable when deliverable_ready is false and snapshots published_deliverable on publish — verified end-to-end.
routers/rendering.py:asset endpoint has path-traversal guard and correct media_map for html/pdf/epub/pptx/png/mp4/mp3 — content-type headers verified for all formats served.
Nit: /api/rendering/asset/{fname} has no auth (by design for public asset URLs). Consider signed/expiring URLs if these should not be publicly enumerable.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing products: Book c4530d52..., Presentation a3a3326e..., Poster f464e59c...; queried /api/products for a 'Ready for Release' or 'Published' certified candidate for release-idempotency test, and for a gates-unmet candidate for lock test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MT-024 backend is green. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mt024_deliverable.py is idempotent and safe to re-run — release test prefers an already-Published certified product for idempotent re-release when no Ready-for-Release candidate exists. Pytest addopts include xdist by default; run with `-o addopts=""` to force serial execution.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All acceptance criteria in the ticket verified: (1) render-deliverable returns ready=true with correct primary_format/preview_url/download_url/files[] and validation.checks all passed for Book(html+epub+pdf), Presentation(html+pptx+pdf), Poster(html+png). (2) Assets served with correct Content-Type headers and valid magic bytes (%PDF, PK for zip, PNG signature). (3) Pipeline exposes customer_deliverable, deliverable_ready, cover_url, thumbnail_url. (4) Release publishes with published_deliverable snapshot; unmet-gate products return HTTP 400 with 'Release locked. Pending gates' and are not published. (5) Re-render is idempotent. (6) Unknown pid returns 404 (not 500).
